production.note: US model years 2016-2023. Start: Chevrolet's September 2015 release gives the 2016 Camaro's "2.0L Turbo" figures. End: GM Authority's 2024 Camaro page records the "deletion of the turbocharged 2.0L LTG engine" for 2024 (source gmauthority-camaro-2024). GM Authority's 2020 page lists the LTG on the LS and LT trims (source gmauthority-camaro-2020).

body.note: The 2017 brochure lists 2.0L Turbo curb weights for both coupe and convertible.

configuration.note: LTG. GM Authority: "2.0L Turbocharged I-4 (LTG)"; Motor Authority: "the 2.0-liter turbo four" (source motorauthority-camaro-2016-specs).

displacementL.note: Chevrolet states "2.0L". No opened page gives the cc figure.

drivetrain.note: GM Authority: "Like all sixth-generation units of the Chevrolet Camaro, the 2024 Camaro rides on GM's Alpha platform" with "Drive Wheels | rear-Wheel-Drive".

transmission.note: 2017 brochure: 2.0L Turbo with 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic. The 2016 release lists 0-60 times for both "(man.)" and "(auto.)" (source chevrolet-camaro-performance-release-2015); GM Authority 2020: 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic (source gmauthority-camaro-2020).

powerHp.note: Quote, Chevrolet's release of September 14, 2015, table row "2016 Camaro", 2.0L Turbo column: "275 hp / 295 lb-ft, 3,339 lbs (auto), 12.1 lbs/hp". 2017 brochure: "275 hp @ 5500 rpm" (source chevrolet-camaro-brochure-2017). Unchanged through 2020 at least: GM Authority "275 / 205 @ 5600 rpm" (source gmauthority-camaro-2020; the rpm differs from the brochure's 5500).

weightLb.note: Manufacturer curb weight, 2017 2.0L Turbo coupe with the 6-speed manual. Quote (2017 brochure): "3,354 lbs. (manual Coupe)"; automatic coupe "3,339 lbs. (automatic Coupe, LT only)"; convertible "3,647 lbs." (manual) and "3,627 lbs." (automatic). The 2018 brochure prints the same figures (source chevrolet-camaro-brochure-2018). Chevrolet's 2016 release gives only the automatic coupe, 3,339 lb, matching the brochure; the 2016 brochure could not be opened (HTTP 429), so 2017 is the first year with a manual figure and is the reference year. The brochure was read through the summarising fetch tool, which reproduced 3,354 four times across the two brochures.
